# GitHub fixtures of the rows of ../dialect.md, where markfmt's grammar and
# GitHub give a document a different meaning, one per line: the example ID,
# the rule, a colon, and the section of ../markfmt/grammar.txt whose case gives
# markfmt's expected HTML. The test fails when an entry no
# longer differs, when its case is missing or has another input, and when an
# entry is also in failing.txt.
10 dialect row, code span after an unmatched backtick run: github 10
11 dialect row, definition title that other characters follow on its line: github 11
13 dialect row, vt and ff in a link destination: github 13
14 dialect row, unicode punctuation for flanking: github 14
15 dialect row, html block kind 4 start: github 15
16 dialect row, html block kind 7 on a lazy candidate line: github 16
17 dialect row, html block kind 6 tag list with search: github 17
18 dialect row, html block kind 6 tag list without source: github 18
19 dialect row, raw html comments: github 19
20 dialect row, vt and ff at the ends of an info string: github 20

22 dialect row, vt and ff in a link label: github 22
23 dialect row, list items that start on one line: github 23
29 dialect row, footnote reference whose caret is an escape or an entity reference: github 29
37 dialect row, footnote reference label across a line ending: github 37
